mahalaya.title: মহালয়া
mahalaya.description: The complete 20-part Mahalaya transmission—from Birendra Krishna Bhadra’s Mahishasura Mardini to the invocations and songs that have travelled through generations of early-morning radios.

agomoni.title: আগমনী
agomoni.description: Songs of Uma coming home—the first dhaak in the distance, shiuli underfoot and the unmistakable feeling that Pujo is almost here.

retro.title: ফিরে দেখা পুজো
retro.description: The Pujor gaan era revisited—voices from old radios, treasured records and cassettes that once announced the season’s arrival.
featuredTrack: Coffee Houser Sei Addata Aaj Aar Nei

modern.title: নতুন পুজোর গান
modern.description: The songs defining Pujo now—new releases, familiar voices and modern arrangements built for the season’s newest memories.

pandal.title: প্যান্ডেলের সুর
pandal.description: The big choruses and rhythmic favourites that follow you from one pandal to the next, through crowds, lights and late-night streets.

biday.title: বিদায়বেলা
biday.description: A quieter Dashami frequency for sindoor, embraces and the long procession home—celebration held together with the ache of goodbye.

asche-bochor.title: আসছে বছর আবার হবে
asche-bochor.kicker: Return · The promise of next year
asche-bochor.description: The farewell turns forward. A hopeful closing broadcast built around reunion, renewal and the promise that Pujo always returns.

misc.title: এদিক–ওদিক
misc.kicker: Open frequency · Folk, fusion and beyond
misc.description: The songs that refuse one neat shelf: folk, fusion, devotional pieces, film music and unexpected selections that still feel like Pujo.
